spec.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, sqlite3, json
paths = [
 'inputs/chall/unknown.data',
 'store/jobs/j000052/out/contact.rar',
 'store/jobs/j000067/out/confidential.eml',
 'store/jobs/j000067/out/archive/contact/unlink.db',
 'store/jobs/j000067/out/archive/contact/instance1/unlink.db',
 'store/jobs/j000145/out/contact/contact/unlink.db',
 'store/jobs/j000145/out/contact/contact/instance1/unlink.db',
]
needles=[b'name_client',b'client_email',b'private_key',b'infobreakage_dbkey',b'private key']
result=[]
for p in paths:
    item={'path':p}
    if not os.path.isfile(p): item['status']='missing'; result.append(item); continue
    b=open(p,'rb').read(); item['size']=len(b); item['first16_hex']=b[:16].hex()
    item['matches']={}
    for n in needles:
        arr=[]; start=0
        while True:
            i=b.find(n,start)
            if i<0: break
            arr.append(i); start=i+1
        n16=b''.join(bytes([x,0]) for x in n)
        arr16=[]; start=0
        while True:
            i=b.find(n16,start)
            if i<0: break
            arr16.append(i); start=i+1
        if arr or arr16: item['matches'][n.decode()]={'ascii_count':len(arr),'utf16le_count':len(arr16),'ascii_offsets':arr[:12],'utf16le_offsets':arr16[:12]}
    if p.endswith('.db'):
        try:
            c=sqlite3.connect('file:'+os.path.abspath(p)+'?mode=ro&immutable=1', uri=True)
            item['sqlite_schema']=[{'name':r[0],'type':r[1]} for r in c.execute("select name,type from sqlite_master order by type,name")]
            item['sqlite_page_count']=c.execute('pragma page_count').fetchone()[0]
            c.close()
        except Exception as e: item['sqlite_open_error']=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:100]
    result.append(item)
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
PY
